name: FunctionGemma first bench run
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cp /tmp/fcvocab.bin ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcvocab.bin && cp /tmp/fcbpe.bin ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcbpe.bin && cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--functiongemma-270m-it/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && timeout 250 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcvocab.bin 2 0 ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcbpe.bin > /tmp/fcbench.log 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?; grep -a -c "^enc:" /tmp/fcbench.log; grep -a -E "^[0-9]+ " /tmp/fcbench.log | head -1 | cut -c1-70; grep -a "METRIC" /tmp/fcbench.log | head -1'
